long_description:
Come and join us for a fun-filled evening of Bollywood music, dance, laughter and community spirit as we celebrate the joy of Diwali together.

Let’s come together to enjoy some great Bollywood tunes, make wonderful memories, meet friends and celebrate the festival of lights in a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

Whether you love dancing, Bollywood music or simply spending time with friends and family, there is something for everyone!

Everyone is welcome. Bring your family and friends and be part of this joyful celebration.

We look forward to seeing you all for an evening filled with music, happiness and festive vibes.

Organised by Tamils of North East – ToNE, promoting culture, heritage and community togetherness.
